focus: Verify that agent plans, observations, judgments, authorizations, executions, and confirmations remain distinct states.
Bind every delegated task and returned artifact to the exact request, actor, repository state, and validity window.
Attack hidden authority escalation, circular delegation, silent provider substitution, stale context, and false completion claims.
Require explicit stop conditions, human escalation paths, dissent, and recovery when evidence or authority is unresolved.
Keep CI and model outputs advisory unless a separately verified human authorization and execution contract exists.
